framework.name: BTC Macro Domino Sequence
framework.summary: Business cycle turns higher → copper outperforms gold → BTC volatility expands → BTC reaches a cycle top.

sequence.name: US business cycle
sequence.detail: ISM Manufacturing PMI 53.3 — expansion threshold is 50.

sequence.name: Copper / gold breakout
sequence.detail: Above the three-year regression trendline and 200D average.

sequence.name: BTC cycle top
sequence.detail: Objective proxy: log z-score -0.9186 and RSI 65.35; fires when z ≥ 1.5 and RSI ≥ 70.

framework.warning: Research framework and decision support only. Thresholds are transparent dashboard rules, not investment advice.

source.name: Video-provided ISM Manufacturing PMI snapshot

copper_gold.detail: Above the three-year regression trendline and 200D average.
copper_gold.method: Breakout = ratio > 2% above a three-year linear trendline and above its 200D moving average.

btc_realized_volatility.method: 90-day standard deviation of daily log returns, annualized with √365.

oil.rule: Elevated watch above $80 with >5% 20-session rise; high risk at/above $100.
